No items are available to trade right now.
You survived the giant shadows and earned every trophy.
A rainy night downtown. I was on my way to the park to meet someone.
A single flower from the florist. Such a small flower, carrying such big feelings.
A male police officer gave me a Secret Cosplay Club membership card. It seems to be a club for lovers of niche cosplay.
I peeked into a ruined building and saw bundles of cash flying everywhere. Who are those two men in black?
My first run-in with a giant shadow. I need to get out of this city, fast...
A girl seeking the hamburger she and her dad shared.
While the two men in black were chasing me, a mysterious man saved me. Is he on my side...?
I put out lots of fires. When using an extinguisher, make sure the fire's really out.
A Girl, Her Dad, and a Sister Like Yuki
I brought the girl back to her father. Yuki was as kind to her as a big sister.
A Promise on the Night Ship
The first mate and Dr. Fukazawa promised to share their hidden feelings.
I drove a forklift for the first time. Now I can lift containers with it.
I gave the backup password to office workers still on the job.\nThey were fighting a deadline while giant shadows attacked the city.
The train driver was worn out by passengers who did nothing but complain.\nAgreeing with him seemed to cheer him up a little.
I never expected a balance that big. Maybe that's normal for a company account, but it reminded me: the money's always out there somewhere.
I rescued Yuki and escaped the tower. It turns out the tower had become the giant birds' nest.
I want to see Yuki again... And she answered my feelings.
The chief researcher and I made a secret promise.
I delivered the program to the institute's deputy director. That should move the sky-flash research along.
I feel like I got a really nice costume. I just have that feeling.
I got a W&P Consulting brochure. It seems to be a company that deals in weapons intelligence.
I bought a building from a certain gentleman.\nNow I own a building!
In the raging wind, Yuki reached out her hand to me. We've overcome so much together already.
I made it through! Riding out the blast behind us with Risa, on to the next stage.
In a convenience store in the evacuated city, I met a woman hiding out.
I accepted that I am the savior and blessed the people. Those who received my blessing will be safe from the giant shadows.
You smashed something with a tackle.
You changed costumes for the first time.
You collected loads of KYOEI NEWS stories.
